correctStatements.text: At 15:00 Haruto relayed that store staff saw items shown in stock in the app that were actually sold out.
At 15:07 Sigrid noticed the API responses carried an inventory timestamp from 09:15 that morning.
Nnamdi found the cache TTL had been set to 86400 seconds instead of 60 in the previous night config change.
Carolina counted around 230 orders placed for out-of-stock items.
At 15:20 Nnamdi decided to revert the TTL and flush the inventory cache.
At 15:26 Nnamdi reverted the configuration and flushed the cache.
At 15:33 Sigrid verified responses carried fresh timestamps and counts matched the warehouse system.
At 15:50 Carolina said support began contacting the 230 customers with refund or wait options.
At 16:05 Haruto got confirmation from stores that the app was correct again and resolved the incident.
Nnamdi will require a second reviewer for cache configuration changes.
Sigrid will implement an alert when inventory data is older than 5 minutes.
Haruto summarised that a mistaken cache TTL served stale stock levels for roughly six hours and led to about 230 oversold orders.
